innovation.summary: The project introduces innovative features that allow players to create and customize their own racetracks and vehicles. It leverages AI-generated content to enhance game development and streamline prototyping processes.
key_points: Players can create their own tracks by driving around in maps, finding the best spot, adding structures, and recording their racetrack.
Players can customize their cars by choosing specifications such as speed, turning ability, and airtime before crashing.
Customization options for cars include decals, colors, and tires, with no microtransactions involved.
Race modifiers can be added to enhance variety, impacting the state of the map and visibility.
Environmental conditions listed as race modifiers include fog, lightning storms, windstorms, mud fields, and rainfall.
AI will be used to help express ideas for the game and speed up the prototype steps.
